title: Tasty Chilaquiles Casserole
description: A flavorful breakfast dish with crispy tortilla chips, melted cheese, and a hint of Mexican spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the shredded cheese until well combined.
Arrange half of the tortilla chips in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the milk and egg mixture over the tortilla chips.
Sprinkle the remaining tortilla chips on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and top with salsa, cilantro, and plants-based sour cream.
Return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes to warm through.
